metrics.label: ARR
metrics.why: Annualized recurring revenue. The headline value indicator at SaaS Series A.

metrics.label: MRR
metrics.why: Monthly recurring revenue, used to derive growth velocity in months not years.

metrics.label: Revenue growth QoQ
metrics.why: The single most VC-watched metric at Series A. Compounds into "T2D3" trajectories.

metrics.label: Gross margin
metrics.why: AI products under inference-cost pressure. <60% GM raises long-term unit economics flags.

metrics.label: Net burn (monthly)
metrics.why: Indicates capital efficiency and runway. Burn multiple = burn / new ARR.

metrics.label: Runway months
metrics.why: Months of cash at current burn. <12 months triggers fundraise pressure.

metrics.label: Total users
metrics.why: Top-line user count. Usually triangulable through reviews + downloads + traffic.

metrics.label: Monthly active users
metrics.why: MAU separates real engagement from registration vanity.

metrics.label: Paying customers
metrics.why: Number of accounts paying. Conversion lever for SMB-AI products.

metrics.label: Logo growth QoQ
metrics.why: Net new logos quarter-over-quarter, separates expansion from new acquisition.

metrics.label: Self-serve revenue share
metrics.why: High self-serve share = scalable economics; low = sales-led with higher CAC.

metrics.label: Web traffic (monthly visits)
metrics.why: Top-of-funnel demand signal, requires Similarweb + Semrush corroboration.

metrics.label: Branded search index
metrics.why: Google Trends index for the brand name, removes paid distortion.

metrics.label: App downloads (monthly)
metrics.why: For mobile-first products, this is the cleanest acquisition signal.

metrics.label: Blended CAC
metrics.why: Cost to acquire one paying customer across all channels.

metrics.label: Channel mix (organic vs paid)
metrics.why: Healthy products show ≥50% organic share at scale.

metrics.label: Gross revenue retention
metrics.why: Revenue retained excluding upsell. Below 80% signals product-market problems.

metrics.label: Net revenue retention
metrics.why: Most-watched SaaS metric. Above 120% signals expansion-led growth.

metrics.label: DAU/MAU ratio
metrics.why: Engagement intensity. <20% in B2B SMB is a warning, ≥40% is excellent.

metrics.label: 6-month cohort retention
metrics.why: Real durability test, smooth out monthly noise.

metrics.label: Logo churn (monthly)
metrics.why: Account-level churn. >3%/mo at SMB is concerning, <2% is healthy.

metrics.label: Review velocity (count)
metrics.why: Public proxy for active-customer growth via G2/App Store cadence.

metrics.label: Average rating
metrics.why: Avg star rating across major review surfaces, weighted by recency.

metrics.label: LTV
metrics.why: Customer lifetime value. At SMB use 24-month forward ARR estimate.

metrics.label: LTV / CAC
metrics.why: Capital efficiency proxy. <3 weak, ≥4 strong.

metrics.label: Gross margin per customer
metrics.why: Per-customer GM exposes product-mix issues hidden in blended GM.

metrics.label: Inference cost / revenue
metrics.why: AI-specific. >25% is structural margin risk.

metrics.label: CAC payback months
metrics.why: Time to recover acquisition cost. <12mo healthy SaaS, <18mo acceptable.

metrics.label: Release cadence (per month)
metrics.why: Velocity is a proxy for engineering health and product-market urgency.

metrics.label: Notable feature ships (Q)
metrics.why: Number of notable features shipped per quarter, from changelog or PR.

metrics.label: Product Hunt #/launches
metrics.why: Launch ranking + reception. Top-3 Day signals strong indie distribution.

metrics.label: Competitive share signal
metrics.why: Relative traffic and reviews vs top 3 competitors.

metrics.label: Headcount (LinkedIn)
metrics.why: Most reliable public scale indicator. QoQ delta is the trend signal.

metrics.label: Headcount QoQ %
metrics.why: ≥10% QoQ at Series A is healthy, ≥20% is strong, contraction is a flag.

metrics.label: Senior hires (Q)
metrics.why: VP/Director/Head-of hires signal scaling discipline and capital deployment.

metrics.label: Open roles
metrics.why: Forward-looking hiring intent. Function mix shows strategic priorities.

metrics.label: Senior departures (Q)
metrics.why: Multiple senior departures within 60d is a serious red flag.

metrics.label: Engineering ratio
metrics.why: Engineering as % of headcount. AI-heavy companies typically 50–65%.

metrics.label: Months since last priced round
metrics.why: Most companies raise on 18–24 month cycles. Lengthening signals bridge risk.

metrics.label: Cash position
metrics.why: Absolute USD on balance sheet. Combine with burn for runway.

metrics.label: Lead investor signaling
metrics.why: Recent partner posts/podcasts about portfolio = bullish; silence/disposal = bearish.

metrics.label: Term sheet activity
metrics.why: Insider-only. Indicates fundraise tempo and pricing trajectory.

metrics.label: Google Trends (12mo idx)
metrics.why: Branded search interest, normalized 0–100. Sustained >50 = mindshare.

metrics.label: Aggregate social followers
metrics.why: LinkedIn + X + TikTok + YouTube combined. Velocity > level.

metrics.label: Tier-1 press mentions (Q)
metrics.why: TC/Bloomberg/WSJ/FT/Information mentions per quarter.

metrics.label: Founder posting cadence
metrics.why: Public posting cadence reveals fundraise/hiring posture.

metrics.label: Board composition
metrics.why: Director changes filed in Delaware. Board adds = capital event signals.

metrics.label: Founder commitment signals
metrics.why: Equity sales, side ventures, public posture toward Zeely.

metrics.label: Litigation / legal exposure
metrics.why: PACER + state court filings. Any active litigation requires triangulation.

metrics.label: IP filings (TM/patent)
metrics.why: USPTO trademark and patent filings. Forward-looking product/branding signal.
